title: Poolside AI releases Laguna XS.2 open-weight 33B MoE coding model
summary: Poolside AI, a newly emerging open-source lab, released Laguna XS.2, a 33-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with three billion active parameters, trained on Poolside's own infrastructure. The model is designed for agentic coding and long-horizon workflows and is licensed under Apache 2.0.

web_findings.title: Introducing Laguna XS.2 and Laguna M.1
web_findings.snippet: Apache 2.0 33B MoE with 3B active; positioned as Poolside's first open-weight release.

web_findings.title: Poolside Laguna XS.2 SWE-bench score
web_findings.snippet: XS.2 reaches 68.2 percent on SWE-bench Verified.
